class.name: TerrainDataMap3D
class.brief_description: Terrain analysis maps for placing vegetation: slope, curvature, flow, wetness, water depth and distance to water.
class.description: Bakes terrain analysis maps over a square of [member size] metres centred on the node, [member resolution] cells a side, for placement rules (grass on gentle slopes, reeds where the ground is wet, trees away from water) and materials. Heights come from [member height_source] or from rays down against [member ground_collision_mask]. Water comes from [member water_sources]. The maps are: - slope and aspect (Horn 1981), - curvature (Zevenbergen and Thorne 1987, positive in hollows), - flow accumulation (multiple flow direction over a depression-filled surface, Priority-Flood), - topographic wetness index [code]ln(a / tan(slope))[/code] (Beven and Kirkby 1979), - water depth and signed distance to water. Query them on the CPU with the [code]get_*_at[/code] methods, or in shaders through the global uniforms described in [method get_shader_code]. Baking runs on the CPU once; it has no per-frame cost.

method.name: bake
method.description: Samples heights and water and computes every map. Returns [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] when no height could be found. Emits [signal baked].

method.name: bake_climate
method.description: Bakes the climate maps with [member climate_recipe] over the map's square plus the recipe's [code]context_margin[/code], on their own grid ([code]sun_cell[/code]): temperature, precipitation, snow fraction, aridity, shortwave, sky view and Winstral Sx. Reads the same [member height_source] (or colliders) as [method bake], and puts the air on the water where [member water_sources] or a [TerrainGenerator3D] [member geology_source] has sea or lakes. Independent of [method bake], which never clears it. Called after the deferred bake when [member bake_on_ready] is on and a recipe is set. See docs/ideas/terrain-generation.md, "Climate maps".

method.name: get_aridity_at
method.description: Aridity index: the year's precipitation over Thornthwaite (1948) potential evapotranspiration, capped at 10. Under 0.2 arid, 0.5 semi-arid, 0.65 dry sub-humid, above that humid (UNEP 1997).

method.name: get_aspect_at
method.description: Direction the ground faces (downhill), in radians from +Z clockwise towards +X, at the nearest cell.

method.name: get_bake_time_msec
method.description: Time the last [method bake] took, in milliseconds.

method.name: get_channel_image
method.description: Returns one map as a single-channel float [Image] ([constant Image.FORMAT_RF]), row 0 at the map's lowest Z.

method.name: get_climate_at
method.description: All climate values at a point: [code]temperature[/code], [code]temperature_january[/code], [code]temperature_july[/code], [code]precipitation[/code], [code]snow_fraction[/code], [code]aridity[/code], [code]shortwave[/code], [code]shortwave_winter[/code], [code]sky_view[/code] and [code]sx[/code] (for the recipe's prevailing wind).

method.name: get_climate_bake_time_msec
method.description: Duration of the last [method bake_climate] in milliseconds.

method.name: get_climate_image
method.description: One climate channel as an [constant Image.FORMAT_RF] image over [method get_climate_rect].

method.name: get_climate_rect
method.description: World XZ rectangle the climate maps cover.

method.name: get_climate_shader_code
method.description: Shader code declaring the [code]terrain_climate_map[/code] and [code]terrain_climate_rect[/code] globals and [code]vec4 terrain_climate(vec3 world_pos)[/code]: mean temperature C, precipitation m a year, annual shortwave kW/m², snow fraction. Only valid after a [method bake_climate] with [member publish_shader_globals] on.

method.name: get_climate_texture
method.description: The climate texture published as [code]terrain_climate_map[/code] (RGBA half floats, see [method get_climate_shader_code]).

method.name: get_curvature_at
method.description: Zevenbergen-Thorne general curvature in 1/m: positive in hollows and valley floors where water collects, negative on ridges.

method.name: get_data_texture
method.description: RGBA float texture: height, slope (radians), aspect (radians), curvature (1/m).

method.name: get_flow_at
method.description: Flow accumulation: log10 of the upslope area in square metres that drains through this point. Flow ends in water, so ground beside a river only collects its own slope.

method.name: get_height_at
method.description: Ground height sampled during the bake.

method.name: get_map_rect
method.description: The baked area in world XZ (position is the corner at the lowest X and Z).

method.name: get_precipitation_at
method.description: Precipitation in mm a year: the linear theory of orographic precipitation (Smith and Barstad 2004) over the recipe's wet-day wind rose, so windward slopes are wetter and lee sides lie in a rain shadow (on ranges tens of km across; on small maps the rain drifts past the crests).

method.name: get_rock_at
method.description: Bare rock exposure at [param global_position], 0 to 1, from [member geology_source] (0 without one).

method.name: get_shader_code
method.description: Shader code that declares the global uniforms [code]terrain_data_map[/code], [code]terrain_water_map[/code] and [code]terrain_data_rect[/code] and the functions [code]terrain_data(world_pos)[/code] (height, slope, aspect, curvature) and [code]terrain_water(world_pos)[/code] (flow, wetness, water depth, signed distance to water). Paste it into a spatial or compute shader. The uniforms are set when [member publish_shader_globals] is on.

method.name: get_shortwave_at
method.description: Mean shortwave on the ground in W/m² over the year (day and night): sun path at the recipe's latitude, terrain horizons in 16 directions, the slope's angle to the sun, diffuse light by the sky view factor, ground reflection and mean cloud cover.

method.name: get_sky_view_at
method.description: Share of the sky the ground sees, 0 to 1 (Dozier and Frew 1990).

method.name: get_slope_at
method.description: Slope in [b]radians[/b], not degrees (0 is flat; [code]rad_to_deg()[/code] for degrees, as [PlantSpecies] slope rules use).

method.name: get_snow_fraction_at
method.description: Share of the year's precipitation that falls as snow, 0 to 1, from the monthly temperatures and the recipe's rain-snow threshold.

method.name: get_soil_depth_at
method.description: Soil depth over bedrock in metres at [param global_position], from [member geology_source] (0 without one).

method.name: get_sx_at
method.description: Winstral Sx in degrees for a wind blowing from [param wind_from_degrees] (clockwise from north, -Z): the mean largest upward angle to the terrain within the recipe's [code]sx_distance[/code] upwind. Positive sheltered (snow drifts in), negative exposed (wind strips it). Interpolated between 16 baked directions.

method.name: get_talus_at
method.description: Scree (talus) cover at [param global_position], 0 to 1, from [member geology_source] (0 without one).

method.name: get_spray_at
method.description: Waterfall spray potential at [param global_position], 0 to 1, from a [TerrainGenerator3D] [member geology_source] ([method TerrainGenerator3D.get_spray_potential]), or from a source node's own [code]get_spray_potential(Vector3)[/code]. 0 without either.

method.name: get_temperature_at
method.description: Air temperature at the surface in C: the year's mean, or on [param day_of_year] (1 to 365) from the seasonal harmonic through the cell's January and July means. From the recipe's temperatures and seasonal lapse rates.

method.name: get_water_depth_at
method.description: Water depth in metres, 0 on land.

method.name: get_water_distance_at
method.description: Signed distance to the shoreline in metres: positive on land, negative under water. [code]1000000[/code] when the map has no water.

method.name: get_water_texture
method.description: RGBA float texture: flow (log10 m²), wetness index, water depth (m), signed distance to water (m).

method.name: get_wetness_at
method.description: Topographic wetness index [code]ln(a / tan(slope))[/code], a = upslope area per metre of contour. Higher is wetter: about 4 to 7 on hillsides, 10 and above on flat ground where water collects (meadows, swamps).

method.name: get_winter_shortwave_at
method.description: Mean shortwave on the ground in W/m² over the three winter months (December to February, or June to August south of the equator), when low sun leaves shaded valleys and north faces dark.

method.name: has_climate
method.description: [code]true[/code] after a [method bake_climate].

method.name: has_geology
method.description: Whether the last bake read a [member geology_source]. [PlantSpecies] soil, rock and talus rules apply only then.

method.name: is_baked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after a successful [method bake].

method.name: queue_bake
method.description: Bakes at the end of the frame, once, however many times it is called.

members.member: Bake one frame after the node is ready (not in the editor), once terrain deformers and colliders are in place.
Exponent of the slope weight in multiple flow direction routing (Holmgren 1994). Around 1.1 spreads flow over hillsides like real overland flow; higher values concentrate it into channels.

Optional [TerrainGenerator3D] (or any node with [code]get_geology_at(Vector3) -> Color[/code] returning soil depth, rock and talus in r, g, b) whose geology is baked into the map with the rest, so plant placement can keep trees off bare rock and scree.
Physics layers hit by the rays used where [member height_source] gives no height.

Node that gives ground heights: a [TerrainDeformer3D], any node with [code]get_height(Vector3)[/code], or a Terrain3D node (its [code]get_data().get_height()[/code]). Empty: rays against [member ground_collision_mask].
Set the global shader uniforms from [method get_shader_code] after each bake.
Cells per side. The cell size is [member size] / [member resolution].
Width of the square map in metres, centred on the node.

Water nodes. A node with [code]get_water_level()[/code] (a water surface) is a level plane at its height plus that level, its waves left out: over the whole map for an open sea, and only inside the outline for a surface with a [code]surface_mesh[/code] (a lake; cells within the outline's bounds ask [code]is_wet()[/code], else [code]sample_height()[/code]). Otherwise a node with [code]sample_height(Vector3)[/code] (such as a river) gives its surface height, -INF outside it. A river that also has [code]get_section_count()[/code] and [code]get_section(index)[/code] ([PhysXRiver3D]) is only asked about the cells near its channel, so world-size maps bake in seconds.

constants.constant: Signed distance to water in metres.
Soil depth over bedrock in metres (from [member geology_source]).
Mean air temperature at the surface, C.
Share of the year's precipitation falling as snow.
Aridity index, precipitation over potential evapotranspiration.
Mean shortwave over the year, W/m².
Mean shortwave over the winter months, W/m².
